intro: The right engine job starts with the cause and condition, not an automatic order for a whole engine. We discuss the relevant services below as part of an assessed, written scope.

services.title: Engine Rebuilds and Reconditioning
services.text: Strip-down, cleaning, inspection, measurement and the agreed overhaul of a recoverable engine. Parts, machining and assembly are matched to the actual unit and damage rather than a universal package for every model.
services.fullText: Strip-down, cleaning, inspection, measurement and the agreed overhaul of a recoverable engine. Parts, machining and assembly are matched to the actual unit and damage rather than a universal package for every model.

image.alt: Engine being stripped down for reconditioning

services.title: Engine Diagnostics and Fault Finding
services.text: Assessment of non-start, mechanical noise, smoke, pressure, cooling and running concerns. Fault-code information is combined with appropriate mechanical evidence; a warning message alone does not identify internal damage.
services.fullText: Assessment of non-start, mechanical noise, smoke, pressure, cooling and running concerns. Fault-code information is combined with appropriate mechanical evidence; a warning message alone does not identify internal damage or prove that rebuilding is required.

services.title: Timing-Chain, Timing-Belt and Timing-Failure Repairs
services.text: The fitted engine determines the drive system and access. Contained timing work and repair after internal damage are different jobs. We establish the condition before recommending a limited repair or a larger overhaul.
services.fullText: The fitted engine determines the drive system and access. Contained timing work and repair after internal damage are different jobs. We establish the condition before recommending a limited repair or a larger overhaul.

services.title: Cylinder-Head, Crankshaft and Engine-Block Assessment
services.text: Inspection and measurement establish what can be recovered. Machining is specified where technically suitable; significant hard-part repair or replacement is separately agreed. Not every head needs skimming, and not every crankshaft is recoverable.
services.fullText: Inspection and measurement establish what can be recovered. Machining is specified where technically suitable; significant hard-part repair or replacement is separately agreed. Not every head needs skimming, and not every damaged crankshaft is economically recoverable.

image.alt: Cylinder head and engine block inspection

services.title: Cooling, Lubrication and Engine Ancillary Repairs
services.text: The original cause may involve oil supply, cooling, ventilation, fuel or forced-induction equipment. Turbocharger, injector and exhaust-system concerns are assessed and itemised where relevant to the engine work; they are not automatically renewed within every rebuild.
services.fullText: The original cause may involve oil supply, cooling, ventilation, fuel or forced-induction equipment. Turbocharger, injector and exhaust-system concerns are assessed and itemised where relevant to the engine work; they are not automatically renewed within every rebuild.

services.title: Associated Clutch, Flywheel and Mechanical Work
services.text: Where removal or the agreed repair exposes related mechanical requirements, discuss them before work proceeds. Clutch, flywheel or connected-system work has its own condition and scope rather than being silently included in the engine guide.
services.fullText: Where removal or the agreed repair exposes related mechanical requirements, discuss them before work proceeds. Clutch, flywheel or connected-system work has its own condition and scope rather than being silently included in the engine guide.

services.title: Bespoke Performance Engine Projects
services.text: Discuss the engine, intended use, modifications and build goals with Boby before agreeing a project. Parts specification, testing and applicable terms are set separately. A standard road-engine rebuild guide or warranty should not be assumed to cover every tuned or track-focused build.
services.fullText: Discuss the engine, intended use, modifications and build goals with Boby before agreeing a project. Parts specification, testing and applicable terms are set separately. A standard road-engine rebuild guide or warranty should not be assumed to cover every tuned or track-focused build.
